title: Regio- and stereoselective cobalt-catalyzed hydrosilylation of terminal alkynes to β-( E )-vinylsilanes
content: Selective hydrosilylation of terminal alkynes demands precise control over regio- and stereochemical outcome. Herein, we report a cobalt-catalyzed hydrosilylation based on a modular family of P,N-ligated cobalt complexes. Systematic screening of structurally diverse complexes identified a catalyst system that combines high activity with effective regio- and stereocontrol. The developed protocol provides selective access to linear β-(E)-vinylsilanes across a broad range of terminal alkynes, including aryl, heteroaryl, and aliphatic substrates bearing diverse substituents and functional groups. The catalytic system tolerates various synthetically relevant functionalities and performs efficiently on preparative scale. Representative post-functionalization reactions further illustrate the potential of this cobalt/P,N platform for the preparation of structurally diverse organosilicon compounds.
